goal: Build Perfpal, a static-analysis tool that extracts performance-relevant heuristics from codebases, renders insightful visual bottleneck maps, and emits LLM-consumable quantifiable metrics to enable AI-driven optimization.
current_phase: Perfpal Atlas: research/planning DONE (D-pf-239/240) — developer-needs brief, metrics contract, data-gap audit, layout spec, inclusion rule, ADR-0009/0010 + V8 spec amendments, build plan atlas-build. Founder ratification of the ADRs + A2 pending; no implementation.
